record.question: According to RPwD Act, 2016, Blindness means a condition where a person has, after best correction:
options: Limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 5 degree
Limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 10 degree
Limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 15 degree
Limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 20 degree
record.explanation: Answer B: Limitation of the field of vision subtending an angle of less than 10 degree. The RPwD Act definition includes limitation of visual field to less than 10 degrees after best correction. Reference: https://www.indiacode.nic.in/bitstream/123456789/12915/1/the_rights_of_persons_with_disabilities_act%2C_2016_no._49_of_2016_date_27.12.2016.pdf. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: October 2025 examination (cover page); answer time-sensitive wording as of then.. Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
